moments.title: FIH Hockey World Cup Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 begins on August 15th in Belgium and the Netherlands, featuring England, Scotland, and Wales, with free-to-air coverage for all home nations matches.

angles.name: Main event build-up
angles.copy: Get ready! The FIH Hockey World Cup kicks off this Friday, August 15th, with England, Scotland, and Wales all in action. Catch every home nation game live and free!

angles.name: Wales specific
angles.copy: Cymru am Byth! Wales are heading to the FIH Hockey World Cup, starting this Friday. Don't miss a minute of their journey, live on S4C!

angles.name: England vs Wales clash
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! England and Wales men go head-to-head in a massive Hockey World Cup clash on August 19th. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Community Shield: Man City vs Arsenal
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield 2026, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will take place on Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Match anticipation
angles.copy: It's the traditional curtain-raiser! Arsenal v Manchester City in the Community Shield next Sunday, August 16th, live from Cardiff. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff host city
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage! The Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield next Sunday as Arsenal face Man City. Are you heading to the capital?

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting August 14th.

angles.name: Concert hype
angles.copy: London, get ready! The Weeknd kicks off five nights at Wembley Stadium this Thursday, August 14th. Who's got tickets to the After Hours Til Dawn Tour?

angles.name: Tour success
angles.copy: The biggest R&B stadium tour in history hits Wembley! The Weeknd's After Hours Til Dawn Tour is set to electrify London for five nights from August 14th.

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's O2 Arena on August 15th, her first live performances in six years.

angles.name: Concert hype
angles.copy: She's back! Ariana Grande starts her epic ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine' residency at London's O2 Arena this Friday, August 15th. Who managed to snag tickets?

angles.name: Residency excitement
angles.copy: Ten nights of Ariana Grande at The O2! The 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' kicks off its London run on August 15th. Get ready for some pop perfection!

moments.title: Boomtown Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Fair returns to Hampshire from August 12th to 16th, promising a unique festival experience with a diverse lineup.

angles.name: Festival countdown
angles.copy: Boomtown is calling! The legendary festival kicks off in Hampshire this Wednesday, August 12th. Who's ready for the wildest week?

angles.name: Unique experience
angles.copy: Beyond the music, Boomtown Fair is an experience! Running August 12-16, get ready for an unforgettable journey into its unique world.

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot for a massive 60th week with 'REIN ME IN' on the Official Singles Chart (Aug 6 - Aug 12, 2026), while Ariana Grande makes a new entry.

angles.name: Chart topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'REIN ME IN' is #1 on the Official Singles Chart for an incredible 60th week. What a run!

angles.name: New entry spotlight
angles.copy: New music alert! Ariana Grande's 'PETAL' is a fresh entry at Number 4 on the Official Singles Chart. Have you heard it yet?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Patti Austin
moments.blurb: Today, August 9th, marks the 76th birthday of acclaimed American R&B and jazz singer Patti Austin.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Patti Austin, who turns 76 today! What's your favourite track from the legendary soul vocalist?

angles.name: Music spotlight
angles.copy: Celebrating the soulful sound of Patti Austin on her 76th birthday! From 'Baby, Come To Me' to 'In My Life', her voice is timeless.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Kenny Gamble
moments.blurb: Philly Soul legend, songwriter, and producer Kenny Gamble celebrates his 83rd birthday today, August 9th.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Kenny Gamble! A true pioneer of Philly Soul, his influence on music is immeasurable.

angles.name: Legacy highlight
angles.copy: Celebrating the man behind so many hits! Kenny Gamble, co-founder of Philadelphia International Records, turns 83 today. What's your favourite Gamble & Huff production?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Kurtis Blow
moments.blurb: Pioneering American rapper Kurtis Blow, known for hits like 'The Breaks', turns 67 today, August 9th.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Kurtis Blow! A true hip-hop pioneer, responsible for 'The Breaks' and so much more.

angles.name: Hip-hop history
angles.copy: Celebrating an icon! Kurtis Blow, one of the first commercially successful rappers, is 67 today. His impact on music is undeniable.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Anna Kendrick
moments.blurb: American actress and singer Anna Kendrick, known for her roles in Pitch Perfect and Up in the Air, celebrates her 41st birthday today, August 9th.

angles.name: Birthday wish
angles.copy: Happy 41st Birthday to the incredibly talented Anna Kendrick! From Oscar nominations to Pitch Perfect anthems, she does it all.

angles.name: Pitch Perfect nostalgia
angles.copy: It's Anna Kendrick's birthday! Raise a glass (or sing an a cappella tune) for the star of Pitch Perfect, turning 41 today.

moments.title: Devon Hosepipe Ban In Effect
moments.blurb: South West Water implemented a county-wide hosepipe ban across Devon starting Saturday, August 8th, due to prolonged dry weather and high demand.

angles.name: Local alert
angles.copy: A hosepipe ban is now in force across Devon. South West Water urges everyone to play their part as dry conditions continue.

angles.name: Reminder
angles.copy: Don't forget: the Devon hosepipe ban is active from today. Let's all do our bit to conserve water during this dry spell.

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs Takeover Complete
moments.blurb: The £19.6 million takeover deal for Exeter Chiefs by a subsidiary of US-based Cannae Holdings has been officially completed.

angles.name: Local sport news
angles.copy: Big news for local rugby! The £19.6 million takeover of Exeter Chiefs is now complete, bringing new investment to Sandy Park.

angles.name: Club future
angles.copy: A new era for the Exeter Chiefs! The takeover deal is done, promising an exciting future for the club.

moments.title: Exeter Road Closures for Gas Works
moments.blurb: Key routes in Exeter will face closures from Monday, August 10th, until early September due to essential gas works, with diversions in place.

angles.name: Travel alert
angles.copy: Heads up, Exeter drivers! Key routes will be closing from Monday, August 10th, for gas works. Plan your journeys and expect diversions.

angles.name: Commuter advice
angles.copy: Gas works mean road closures in Exeter from Monday. Allow extra time for your commute and follow local diversion signs.

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to begin on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal as the defending champions.

angles.name: Season anticipation
angles.copy: Not long to go! The Premier League season kicks off on August 21st. Who's your pick for champions this year?

angles.name: Football's back
angles.copy: Football fans, rejoice! The Premier League is almost back, starting August 21st. Get ready for another thrilling season!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Nears
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Green Man Festival, a highlight of the Welsh cultural calendar, is just around the corner, taking place in the Brecon Beacons from August 20th to 23rd.

angles.name: Welsh festival hype
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Green Man Festival! Wales' beloved festival returns to the Brecon Beacons from August 20th. Who's excited?

angles.name: Music and culture
angles.copy: Music, arts, and Welsh culture in the Brecon Beacons! Green Man Festival is almost here, running August 20-23. Get ready for a magical weekend.

moments.title: Summer Holidays Winding Down
moments.blurb: For many, the summer holidays are in full swing, but for schools in Scotland, students return on August 12th, with England and Wales following in September.

angles.name: Holiday vibe
angles.copy: Still enjoying the summer holidays? Make the most of it! For Scotland, schools return on August 12th.

angles.name: Back to school prep
angles.copy: The summer holidays are slowly winding down! If you're in Scotland, it's almost time for the kids to go back next week.
